name: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-08-10.26.1) introduced by Victorian Senator [Ralph Babet](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/ralph_babet) (United Australia Party), which means it will be included in the original motion. ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add:* > > *"and, in respect of the Public Governance, Performance and Accountability Amendment (Vaccine Indemnity) Bill 2023, the bill be referred immediately to the Finance and Public Administration Legislation Committee for [inquiry and report by 18 March 2024](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Senate/Finance_and_Public_Administration/VaccineIndemnity47)"*
